documents.results_announcement: Full Year / Interim Financial Results announcement (half-year includes the Interim Financial Report, Appendix 4D)
documents.key_financial_information_xlsx: Key Financial Information Excel workbook (since 1H23) — the one machine-readable P&L source among the majors

measures.core_profit: net profit excluding Notable Items (no cash measure since 1H23; treated as cash-comparable, always flagged)
measures.cti_label: Expense to income ratio, ex Notable Items (excluding Notable Items) — the only expense-to-income row Westpac prints; the slides call it cost to income ratio ex Notable Items
measures.roe_label: ROTE ex Notable Items (return on average tangible equity, excluding Notable Items) — printed under the 'Shareholder value - excluding Notable Items' block; the statutory ROTE row above it, and both 'Return on average ordinary equity' rows, are named variants and never the headline row
measures.ex_volatile_nim: Core NIM (excludes Notable Items and Treasury & Markets)

source_notes: Distilled from research tickets 10 and 11 and the FY25 results announcement p12. Westpac's headline NIM walk is on the excluding-Notable-Items basis. No financial numbers in this file (ADR-0003).
